scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,WORKER -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/web" "wrangler dev"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .worker-build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/worker && node --test scripts/cloudflare/*.test.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.generated.json
